publicSeams.description: Platform integration entry point for tenant-side authentication and session routes.
Cross-feature seam for tenant-session lookup without private repository reach-through.
Shared repository contract for validating active tenant sessions.
Shared provisioning seam for creating tenant-auth onboarding state from tenant-admin workflows.

dependsOn.description: Reads verified tenant-admin bootstrap subject context through tenantAdmins public seams.
Resolves effective tenant auth policy and default password/session constraints through tenantConfiguration public seams.
Validates current tenant visibility during authentication and active-tenant selection.

breakingChangeRisks: Changing tenant-auth session or remediation semantics can break tenant-scoped browser and API authentication flows.
Changing exported onboarding or session lookup seams can break tenantAdmins and tenantConfiguration integration.
